name: TI TMP102
summary: TI TMP102 reusable device protocol/configuration support through declared transport contracts.

evidence.scope: Registered protocol/configuration and simulated bus/backend host cases passed in the 241-case native qualification run on macOS arm64. This does not refresh physical evidence.
No physical TMP102 fixture has been recorded.

limitations: Reads existing conversions through a claimed I2C endpoint; does not wake a shutdown sensor or trigger a fresh conversion.
Physical TMP102 board/device acceptance is missing; bus compatibility does not imply a tested composition.
